summary: Completed authenticated catalogue CRUD with administrator controls, strict money and stock validation, captured versions, retained audit history and reference-aware deletion.
Implemented customer-scoped orders with exact decimal totals, accepted line snapshots, atomic stock reservation, durable checkout idempotency and cancellation that restores inventory once.
Built a responsive catalogue, cart and receipt workflow with preserved drafts, frozen retry requests, conflict recovery and explicit simulated fulfillment.
Added generated non-overwriting setup, fresh migration, repeatable fictional seed, 80 passing checks, four reviewed captures and nine detailed source-grounded learning documents.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Prisma 6.19.2; PostgreSQL 18; React 18; Vite 5.4.21; Playwright 1.60 Chromium
checks.command: node scripts/test-database.mjs verify (55 backend, 8 frontend, 3 setup, 14 browser; types/builds; seed twice; owned cluster shutdown)

limits: Local demo authentication with process-local throttling; no MFA, reset/refresh flow, distributed limiting or atomic in-flight revocation.
No actual payments, taxes, shipping, refunds or notifications. Checkout uses current server prices; quoted-price reconfirmation remains an exercise.
Memory-only cart and retry key with manual export; no draft import/merge. Review history before abandoning an uncertain checkout key.
Fresh dedicated migration only; no automatic unknown-data upgrade, Docker daemon verification, production deployment, comprehensive accessibility audit or power-loss certification.
